Triage: graded `priority:p3`, `Bug`; ⛔ **no `domain:*` applied deliberately** — the fix lands in `objectui`'s `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`, so no objectstack lane owns it and `repo:objectui` is the routing. Rationale: class (a) — a reproducible consequence with the repro named (an `apply_edit` carrying an `add_object` op against an app that has a nav; observe `detectBuiltAppPackage` matching), and the collision is mechanical rather than speculative: the heuristic answers *"did this finish a **whole-app** build?"* with *"does `drafted[]` contain an `app` entry"*, which was exact only while `apply_blueprint` was the sole producer.

`priority:p3`: presentation-class, bounded to edits that stage the app artifact, and ⭐ **explicitly accepted on the producer side** as the cost of restoring the draft card and one-click publish for the main multi-artifact path (cloud#1952). ⛔ Nothing is lost or corrupted; a chat surface renders the wrong card shape.

⭐ **The producer's refusal to paper over this is the part worth preserving, and it should govern the fix.** Truncating the `app` entry out of `drafted[]` to steer this heuristic was **considered and rejected** on the cloud side — it would be a lie in the envelope about what was staged, and **two** consumers read `drafted[]` as ground truth of the staged set (this module, and cloud's `packages/service-ai/src/debug/reconcile.ts`). ⇒ The envelope already carries the disambiguator — **`kind: 'edit'`**, present on `apply_edit` and absent on `apply_blueprint` — so the consumer keys on that. ⛔ Do not "fix" this by changing what the producer emits.

The suggested shape is minimal and correct as written: `detectBuiltAppPackage` returns `undefined` when `obj.kind === 'edit'`, **before** the `drafted[]` scan. One guard, no vocabulary change, and `detectDraftResult` — which is what *should* render an incremental edit, per its own comments that incremental edits "keep their draft card" — is unaffected.

⚠️ **One routing fact this seat measured and is recording, because it is the reason this card has sat for three days: there is no `objectui` twin.** `search_issues` over `objectui` for this shape returns **0**, and that zero is a reading rather than a dead channel — a control query on the same instrument in the same session returned **4** results including objectui#8214 (graded today, same file). ⇒ The objectui execution seat's own backlog carries nothing about this.

That is a consequence of how it was filed, ⛔ not a fault of the filing seat: the cloud PM seat could not write to `objectui` from that session and said so, filed the seam here, and named the reader. ⇒ `repo:objectui` is the mechanism by which that seat is meant to find it. ⚠️ If in practice the `domain:ui` seat sweeps only its own repo, this card is invisible to it and needs a twin filed in `objectui` with `Blocked-by:` — that is a routing decision for whoever owns the cross-repo sweep, and this seat is flagging it rather than silently opening a second card.

⚠️ Freshness: the reading is pinned to `045d20ba` (cloud's then-current `.objectui-sha`) and cloud PR #1960 was "ACCEPTed, landing" at filing. ⇒ Re-read both sides before implementing; the collision may already be live, or the pin may have moved.

⛔ This seat grades and routes only: not claimed, not dispatched, no code.

The fix lands in objectui, so the card is correctly shaped and correctly labelled; ⛔ it is not one of the mis-filed pure-UI cards in this same sweep. The missing piece was only a **state label**.

Type `Bug`: `detectBuiltAppPackage` reading any `drafted[]` carrying a `type:'app'` entry as a whole-app build is a heuristic that will mis-classify once the producer widens, which is the definition of the defect rather than a request.

⚠️ **Freshness is the first thing to check, and this seat has not checked it.** The card was filed 2026-09-04 against `045d20ba`, cloud's then-pinned `.objectui-sha`, and its whole argument rests on the producer change **landing**. Six days have passed. ⇒ before any work: confirm whether cloud PR #1960 merged and whether the pin has moved. If the producer has landed the defect is live; if the pin has not moved there is a divergence window to record. ⛔ Neither is measured here — `objectstack-ai/cloud` is not reachable from this session (the sibling probe `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/hotcrm` returned **403**, and cloud is in the same class), so this is stated as the claiming seat's first step rather than as a reading.
